Geometry/kinematics plus governed heuristic observations; absence is UNKNOWN.

source_layers.scope: Named native runs, not a silent replacement of all210 legacy logs

source_layers.inference: Explicit arrival/service/CPU/memory/deadlines, GPU/offload/migration unsupported where absent. Sidecar, no proven compute-driven flight response.

legacy_communication.snr_sinr_rssi: Neither calculated nor emitted by the current legacy link-quality function
legacy_communication.formula: q=clamp((1-distance/effective_range)*weather*operational*availability,0,1); latency=20+(1-q)*200 ms; P=(1-q)^2*0.25 under the current profile
legacy_communication.realism: Controlled deterministic envelope; old urban_lte_v2x_discrete label does not implement LTE PHY/HARQ/RLC.

legacy_compute.units: cpu_cores, gpu_units (profile scalar), memory_mb, utilization_pct, queue count, deadline tick
legacy_compute.realism: Tick resource-demand/allocation/offload state generator; not measured inference times or full persistent per-job CPU/GPU scheduling.

radio.rx_noise_figure_observation: applied via WifiPhy::SetRxNoiseFigure; no public getter

snr_sinr_rssi.PHY: Yans/WifiPhy uses propagation, interference/error-rate reception internally; no numeric RF observation callback connected in this provider.
snr_sinr_rssi.boundary: Do not substitute BENCH public.network.link.v3 RSSI/SNR: it is a different schema/provider.

limitations: This R1 run has no buildings/shadowing/extra fast fading; R2 code support is not evidence R1 uses it
20MHz channel width,6.5Mbps nominal PHY and8Mbps burst offered load are distinct quantities

native_loss_and_latency.P: ttl_loss_count / mature_accepted_count: unique UDP socket-accepted datagrams whose200ms expiry lies in the1s mature observation window and strictly before observation time; timely RX must be < first_tx+TTL.
native_loss_and_latency.L: Mean RX-first_tx in ms among timely received unique datagrams in the SAME mature accepted cohort. All-dropped/no timely RX is UNKNOWN, not0.
native_loss_and_latency.queue: Actual MAC packet/byte snapshots at t-1ns,2Hz;500packets/500ms lifetime.
native_loss_and_latency.censor: Not yet mature/horizon pending outside denominator; late RX is TTL failure but not asserted permanent PHY loss.
native_loss_and_latency.gateway_estimate: P09 gateway_expected_sequence_loss is scheduled expected telemetry vs timely gateway receipts; distinct definition/version/authority from accepted-TX mature P. Actor acts only on actual downlink accepted command.

actual_radio.rx_noise_figure_observation: applied via WifiPhy::SetRxNoiseFigure; no public getter
